rule: A case is `train` when the first byte of sha256("<seed>:<case directory name>") is below 154 (about 60%), else `test`. The rule depends on the case's name alone, so adding a case never moves another.
seed_note: Drawn at random from 32 bits and redrawn (1 draw in all) until train held 3 of the 5 cases, on case counts only, before any case had been run. Cases added since are assigned by the rule above, never by hand.
